name: Area Light Sampling with Ray-Origin Centering
aliases: Area light sampling with ray-origin centering
definition: A generalization of equi-angular sampling for area lights of arbitrary shapes, where the sample point on the light is used as the center for the sampling equations to distribute error uniformly.
summary: Area Light Sampling with Ray-Origin Centering reduces variance for large lights by using the sampled light point as the ray-segment sampling center, distributing error uniformly instead of approximating with a fixed center.
